hero.title: Commercial License
hero.subtitle: Klacks is open source under the GNU AGPL-3.0. For most organizations, that is all they need. If you want to build Klacks into a closed product or keep your changes private, you can get a commercial license.
agpl.title: The AGPL covers this
agpl.items.0.title: Using Klacks in your organization
agpl.items.0.text: You install Klacks and schedule your staff with it. No license fees and no license agreement.
agpl.items.1.title: Changing Klacks and sharing the changes
agpl.items.1.text: You modify Klacks and make the modified source code available to everyone who uses your installation over a network.
agpl.items.2.title: Running Klacks for clients
agpl.items.2.text: Service providers install and support Klacks for their clients. They publish their own changes under the AGPL.
commercial.title: This needs a commercial license
commercial.items.0.title: Building it into a closed product
commercial.items.0.text: You include Klacks or parts of it in your own software whose source code you do not want to publish.
commercial.items.1.title: Keeping changes private
commercial.items.1.text: You offer a modified version of Klacks over a network without sharing the source code of your changes.
commercial.items.2.title: Policies that exclude the AGPL
commercial.items.2.text: Your organization does not allow software under the AGPL internally.
offer.title: What the license covers
offer.text: The commercial license releases you from the obligations of the AGPL. We agree on scope, term and price individually, based on how you use Klacks.
why.title: Klacks stays open
why.text: Income from commercial licenses funds further development. Klacks remains available to everyone under the AGPL, and so does every accepted community contribution.
cta.title: Request a license
cta.text: Tell us briefly how you plan to use Klacks. You will get a personal reply.
cta.includeHtml:
• Company and country
  • Planned use: own product, cloud service or internal policy
  • Approximate number of installations or end customers
note: This overview explains the AGPL in simplified form and is not legal advice. The license text is authoritative.
